title: In vivo intrinsic (elastic, viscous, inertial) and reflex low-back stiffness from T8 position perturbations, standing with back preload, with and without lumbar belts
condition: standing, pelvis fixed, ACTIVE back extensor preload ~5% of strength (15/10 Nm), abdominals relaxed

quantity.name: trunk mechanical behaviour parameters (system identification)
quantity.definition: parallel-cascade identification of force at T8 vs imposed A-P displacement: intrinsic path = K + B s + I s^2 (K elastic, N/m; B viscous; I inertial) and reflex path (gain x velocity with delay); %VAF = variance accounted for by each path; last 60 s of 75-s trials, 3 trials per condition averaged

source.authors: Lariviere C, Ludvig D, Kearney R, Mecheri H, Caron JM, Preuss R
source.sample: Study 2 (construct validity, data extracted): 10 healthy men (26 (8) y, 1.80 (0.06) m, 80 (13) kg) and 10 healthy women (27 (11) y, 1.68 (0.07) m, 65 (10) kg). Study 1 (reliability; 30 different subjects, 15 M/15 F, ~39-40 y) reported only reliability statistics and figure means (not extracted).

protocol.summary: Upright standing in a position-controlled trunk perturbation apparatus, pelvis restrained, harness at T8 connected to a servo motor; pseudorandom binary sequence of 4-mm forward/backward displacements (rise ~24 ms, < reflex latency), 220 perturbations per trial; subject maintains a filtered-feedback L5/S1 extension preload of 15 Nm (men) or 10 Nm (women) and relaxes the abdominals. Conditions C1-C5 randomised (belt tension 70 mmHg at the flank).
how_to_simulate: Standing model with pelvis fixed and a harness constraint at T8 driven in A-P translation
Activate back extensors to produce 15 Nm (male model) or 10 Nm (female model) L5/S1 extension moment with abdominals near rest (include muscle short-range stiffness; reflex optional)

Apply small (4 mm) A-P displacements at T8 and compute the restoring force; identify K (N/m) from the low-frequency force/displacement relation (or the static stiffness at T8) and compare with C1 (control)

subject_model.source: Study 2 subject means (mean of M and F; derived)

protocol.notes: ACTIVE condition (back extensor preload): stiffness includes muscle contributions; never pool with passive tests. The paper is a reliability/validity study; study-1 reliability data (Tables 1-2) not extracted. K in N/m also given in N/mm.
